summary: BUG1 and BUG2 are both correctly and completely fixed, with all constraints satisfied. FEAT-001 (app/js/ws-client.js): a 20s setInterval ping heartbeat sends a real {type:'ping'} frame over the OPEN socket while _helloAcked, started on hello_ok (including after reconnect) and cleared on both the close event and manual close() with no timer leak; the backend already answers ping with pong (server/room-server.js:523-524) and CLEANUP_DELAY_MS=60000 (line 45), so the 20s interval stays safely under both the ~30-60s idle-disconnect threshold and the 60s cleanup window, keeping the victim's idle room alive until the shaman joins — directly removing the ROOM_NOT_FOUND root cause. FEAT-002 (app/css/theme.css): .bottom-bar gains display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px so #share-btn and #reset-btn each take a row, and a new .fortune-card{padding-bottom:150px} reserves space so neither button is clipped at 375x667 (coder's Playwright measurement recorded both buttons visible and non-overlapping, share bottom 390 / reset bottom 443 within viewport 667 and card 460); single-button screens keep their layout. Backend (server/) was not changed in the task commit range. No new color literals were introduced in the changed CSS/JS — only the locked four-color variables plus the existing 米黄 remain. compliance.js was not touched; its three red-line rules (playful-marker pass-through, surname+title block, surname+name block) are intact. No .env, node_modules, or .mp3 changes appear in the range (the untracked root-level mp3 files are pre-existing test artifacts, never committed). Narrow spot-check of the three frontend unit suites ran 17/17 green, matching the coder's recorded results (backend 18/18 per record, backend unchanged); the applySnapshot reset case covering the reset link stays green.
